landing.title: Build plans for the Berdua WhatsApp + Telegram prospect bot
landing.lede: A multi-channel prospect assistant for Berdua.AI: answers questions about the services from a single source of truth, captures qualified leads into the website contact pipe, understands voice notes, and holds a hardened anti-injection line — provider-agnostic LLM/STT, forked from the proven whatsapp-demo restaurant bot. Each plan below is a sequence of disciplined TDD cycles. Pick a plan to read its cycles and runbook.
